description: FORGOT-PASSWORD screen reworked to the shared auth shell, composed consistently with Login (Figma has no dedicated node, so compose from the same shell + a single email field + submit + back-to-login link). Depends on FEAT-001 (shell/tokens/i18n) and should follow FEAT-002 for visual consistency with Login.
steps: Read context.json, this file, and the Login section of figma-auth.md for the field/label visual pattern to mirror.

Add forgot-password copy to messages/ar.json + en.json (in sync) under the auth namespace: forgotHeading (e.g. 'نسيت كلمة المرور؟'), forgotSubheading (a short instruction consistent with Login's subtitle tone), forgotSubmit (e.g. 'إرسال رابط الاستعادة'), backToLogin (reuse t('loginCta') if suitable). Sensible English equivalents; keep key sets identical.

Create a client form src/features/auth/components/forgot-password-form.tsx: 'use client', useForm over a minimal email schema (either add createForgotPasswordSchema(t) to src/features/auth/schemas.ts reusing the emailRequired/emailInvalid messages, or inline a z.object with email). Render a single email field matching the Login field pattern (Label + required '*', Input md with EmailIcon + placeholder, error

) and a full-width primary submit Button. The submit handler is a typed placeholder (no auth forgot-password API endpoint exists in src/features/auth/api.ts) — do NOT fabricate a backend call; it may show a success toast and/or no-op. Export ForgotPasswordForm from src/features/auth/index.ts without removing existing exports. If a schema factory is added, export it too and add a case to schemas.test.ts.

Edit src/app/[locale]/(auth)/forgot-password/page.tsx: remove the Card usage; render inside the shell card <LogoMark size={144} /> + heading block (t('forgotHeading') title + t('forgotSubheading') subtitle, same classes as Login) + <ForgotPasswordForm /> + a centered secondary underlined Link back to routes.login. Keep setRequestLocale.
Visually confirm consistency with the Login screen (same shell, card, field styling, spacing) in RTL + light/dark; use get_screenshot on the Login node 47:3798 as the styling reference.
acceptance_criteria: forgot-password/page.tsx renders inside the shell (no Card) with logo + heading + email form + back-to-login link, visually consistent with Login.
No fabricated backend call; the submit handler is typed and does not introduce a behavior regression.
ForgotPasswordForm is exported from src/features/auth/index.ts and existing exports remain intact; if a forgot-password schema was added it is covered by schemas.test.ts.
messages ar/en auth key sets stay identical.
verification: From repo root: npm run typegen ; npm run typecheck ; npm run lint ; npm run test ; npm run build — all pass with 0 errors.
findings:
Reworked forgot-password to the shared auth shell, composed to mirror Login exactly (LogoMark size=144, centered heading block with identical classes text-[20px] leading-8 font-semibold text-foreground / text-sm leading-5 text-text-body, form, then centered secondary underlined back-to-login Link). Figma has no dedicated node, so styling was mirrored from Login (node 47:3798) as instructed; no new visual drift possible since the same tokens/classes are reused. Added createForgotPasswordSchema(t) to schemas.ts reusing emailRequired/emailInvalid messages, plus ForgotPasswordSchema/ForgotPasswordValues types. New client component src/features/auth/components/forgot-password-form.tsx renders a single email field matching the Login field pattern (Label + required '*', Input size=md with EmailIcon + placeholder, error

) and a full-width primary submit Button using t('forgotSubmit'). Submit handler is a typed no-op placeholder (handleSubmit(() => {}) over useForm) — no fabricated backend call, since src/features/auth/api.ts has no forgot-password endpoint. Exported ForgotPasswordForm, createForgotPasswordSchema and ForgotPasswordValues from src/features/auth/index.ts; all existing exports kept intact. Added messages/ar.json + en.json keys under auth (in sync): forgotHeading, forgotSubheading, forgotSubmit, backToLogin. Added a 'forgot-password schema' describe block with 3 cases to schemas.test.ts. Page keeps setRequestLocale and now also has generateMetadata via buildMetadata for parity with Login. Verification from repo root all passed with 0 errors: npm run typegen, npm run typecheck, npm run lint (0 errors/0 warnings), npm run test (37 files, 149 tests passed), npm run build (success).
